claims.summary: Verified Coherent Draft v1 is a machine-readable promotion contract: three preregistered 5-, 8-, and 14-lesson packages must pass independent source, claim, render, functional-visual, operation, and quality-benchmark gates without averaging away a failure.

Source authority is field-level and fail-closed. Model-provisional exact-copy markers cannot authorize learner-facing facts, while verified research, instructor-supplied ledgers, and the shipped source library retain explicit authority and claim bindings.

Every Office artifact is replay-rendered and hash-bound. The final V14 campaign passes all 219 documents and decks after removing sparse spill pages without deleting content or shrinking readable 11-point body text.

The compiler now supplies inspectable quantitative operations, authentic language-data coverage, and task-linked visual specimens; exhaustive reviews bind 807 semantic claims to visible artifact anchors while keeping the public checkpoint claim at coherent draft—not classroom validation.

boundaries: Verified Coherent Draft v1 is engineering evidence, not instructor approval or classroom effectiveness.
Remote CI and deployment are not claimed before push.
